versions.content: The DTC-specific Flash Red Stop Lamp shall be set to Slow Flash (0x00) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndi- catorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemRedStopIndicatorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH .

The DTC-specific Flash Red Stop Lamp shall be set to Slow Flash (0x00) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndi- catorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemRedStopIndicatorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH .

The DTC-specific Flash Red Stop Lamp shall be set to Slow Flash (0x00) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndi- catorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemRedStopIndicatorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH .
